t: The facility of the United States Postal Service located at 170 East Main Street in Patchogue, New York, shall be known and designated as the “Lieutenant Michael P. Murphy Post Office Building”.

fable.w: This section only names a post office building. There is no tempting contrary reading: it involves no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
